Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class PlantPipelineEvidence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.PlantPipelineEvidence
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PlantPipelineEvidence extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, fail-closed piping constraint evidence for one completed plant calculation.

This adapter snapshots the existing steady-state PipeBeggsAndBrills pressure, temperature, and mixture-velocity profiles without retaining the mutable pipe. Installed limits are always supplied explicitly by the caller. The class does not promote the pipe's convenience defaults, API RP 14E, FIV, AIV, hydrate, wax, or other screening correlations to verified design capacity.

A complete snapshot requires exact calculation identity, a converged process candidate, caller-confirmed geometry provenance, finite profile values and all six hydraulic/thermal limits. Missing or stale observations remain unavailable rather than becoming zero utilization.
